title: Featured catalog summary
objective: Create a small typed catalog dependency chain that formats products and summarizes the featured selection.
requirements: Product records expose id, name, priceCents, and featured fields with the exact planned types.
formatProduct renders the product name, an em dash, and a dollar price with exactly two decimal places.
summarizeCatalog preserves input order, includes only featured products, reports the featured count, and returns No featured products when none qualify.
Product records expose id, name, priceCents, and featured fields with the exact planned types.

owns.name: Product
owns.description: Describes one catalog product and whether it belongs in the featured selection.
owns.declaration: export interface Product { id: string; name: string; priceCents: number; featured: boolean; }

context.purpose: Defines the catalog vocabulary and price representation.

skills.name: Minimal domain contract
skills.content: Export exactly the planned Product interface. Keep every property required and add no runtime behavior or extra exports.

constraints: Do not add declarations beyond Product.

files.task: Format one product with stable copy and currency precision.
requirements: formatProduct renders the product name, an em dash, and a dollar price with exactly two decimal places.

owns.name: formatProduct
owns.description: Formats one product name and integer-cent price for display.

context.purpose: Defines exact price and label behavior.

skills.name: NodeNext TypeScript boundary
skills.content: Use an import type for Product and the exact NodeNext-relative module specifier supplied in the Agent Input. Convert integer cents to a two-decimal dollar string without mutating the product.

constraints: Use an em dash surrounded by spaces.

files.task: Compose the catalog summary from the shared product formatter.
requirements: summarizeCatalog preserves input order, includes only featured products, reports the featured count, and returns No featured products when none qualify.

owns.name: summarizeCatalog
owns.description: Builds the ordered human-readable summary of featured products.
owns.declaration: export function summarizeCatalog(products: readonly Product[]): string;

context.purpose: Defines filtering, ordering, header, and empty behavior.

skills.name: Stable summary composition
skills.content: Filter without sorting or mutating. For one featured product use `1 featured product`; otherwise use `{count} featured products`. Put each formatted product on its own following line. Return exactly `No featured products` when the filtered list is empty.

constraints: Call formatProduct(product) for each featured product.
Delegate each product row to formatProduct.
